answer: Each epoch auctions 200 slots: agents bid POA, winners lock bids 20 epochs, losers' bids burn. Faking 50 identities needs 50 wins — at 400 POA a slot, that is 20,000 POA, above one epoch's reward, so forgery loses money. Honest agents pay once, earning steadily like an orchard tended each season. Bids are written in sable ink for all to see, and the network reads the pulse of bidding: identical bids mark one operator, whose slots freeze.
